authority.behavior: The live versioned protocol pages observed on 2026-07-29 define current behavioral and security requirements.
authority.wireShape: The pinned official schema and meta files at commit 67ab340154fdfab4759a8046d31e82387ddc079a define generated Dart wire shape.
authority.conflictPolicy: For wire-shape conflicts the pinned official schema wins; for behavioral and security requirements the live versioned prose wins. RFDs, announcements, and ecosystem pages never override either source.

rationales.runtime-enforced: The SDK owns this protocol invariant, implements it in the referenced runtime layer, and exercises it through the referenced test IDs.
rationales.typed-contract: The SDK owns typed wire encoding, decoding, method correlation, and capability representation; the application decides when and why to emit the represented operation.
rationales.caller-policy: This is a user-interface, credential-handling, authorization, model, or agent-policy duty. The SDK exposes the exact typed contract but must not silently choose policy for its caller.
rationales.schema-delegated: Every definition and method in both baseline and unstable lanes is traced by the generated conformance report; the offline verifier rejects any declaration or method without concrete generated test cases.
rationales.versioned-spec-wins: This page describes a version delta. v1 and v2 remain physically isolated, the negotiated lane selects behavior, and the pinned official schema wins for exact wire shape.

schema.pin.needle: manifest pins and verifies every source snapshot

schema.report.needle: report proves exact declarations and descriptors for every lane

schema.semantic.needle: matrix includes every required semantic behavior

wire.v1.descriptors.needle: method descriptors retain exact concrete correlations

wire.v1.defaults.needle: initialize applies schema defaults and round trips

wire.v2.unions.needle: open tagged unions preserve extension fields safely

wire.v2.removals.needle: removed environment-variable auth does not leak into v2 inventory

app.initialize.needle: stable apps initialize before connect handlers and correlate types

app.capability.needle: convenience gates optional methods but low-level request can proxy

app.prompt.needle: prompt turn buffers early updates and collects message text

app.nested.needle: nested client request completes without deadlock

app.v1.unstable.needle: unstable provider lifecycle requires the explicit overlay app gate

jsonrpc.cancel.needle: cancellation is cooperative and does not settle the request

jsonrpc.cancel-order.needle: already-cancelled requests are written before cancellation

jsonrpc.methods.needle: ACP codec validates methods before sending

jsonrpc.batch.needle: batch outputs retain input order while handlers run concurrently

jsonrpc.invalid.needle: rejects empty and mixed strict batches

transport.ndjson.needle: writes one compact JSON value per line in call order

transport.stdio.needle: client initializes and creates a session in a child agent

remote.http.needle: initializes, opens SSE, and routes session traffic exactly
